name: WISE J085510.83-071442.5
method: Forced circular-aperture photometry (r=2.5 native px = 15.4 arcsec) on each individual SPHEREx L2 image at the proper-motion-corrected position for that image's MJD-AVG. Local background = 3-sigma-clipped median in a 6.0-10.0 px annulus (flagged pixels excluded). Surface brightness MJy/sr converted to uJy with the local pixel solid angle from the image WCS (incl. SIP). Aperture correction = 1/(fraction of the image's own EPSF, for the detector zone containing the target, enclosed within r); the EPSF stamp extends to +/-3.3 px so this corrects to the EPSF footprint, not to infinity. Errors from the VARIANCE extension plus background-mean uncertainty.
saturated_definition: any pixel touching the aperture has OVERFLOW or NONLINEAR set; flux is null for these
flagged_definition: any pixel touching the aperture has one of SUR_ERROR,TRANSIENT,NONFUNC,DICHROIC,MISSING_DATA,HOT,COLD,PHANMISS,PERSIST,OUTLIER,CROSSTALK,GHOST,GHOST_FPA,GHOST_EXT,STREAK,BLOOM,SNOWBALL,HALO set, or is NaN (flux null if NaN)
